name: pool_format
description: Buffer Pool and Shared Wasm Memory layout definitions for WebDB

constants.name: DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE_BYTES
constants.description: Default cache buffer pool size in bytes (4 MB = 1024 * 4096).

constants.name: DEFAULT_SLOT_COUNT
constants.description: Default number of page cache slots in the buffer pool (1024).

constants.name: VM_CONTEXT_SIZE
constants.description: Size in bytes allocated for VM execution context state (12 KB).

constants.name: RESULT_BUFFER_SIZE
constants.description: Size in bytes allocated for SQL result row serialization buffer (64 KB).

constants.name: BYTECODE_SIZE
constants.description: Size in bytes allocated for compiled query bytecode instructions (32 KB).

constants.name: PAGE_SCRATCHPAD_SIZE
constants.description: Size in bytes allocated for temporary single-page staging / decompression (4 KB).

constants.name: ALIGNMENT_PADDING_SIZE
constants.description: Padding bytes to align transient execution arena at boundary 0x420000 (12,160 bytes).

constants.name: DEFAULT_MAX_QUERY_MEMORY
constants.description: Maximum memory limit in bytes for transient query execution arena (16 MB).

regions.name: SLOT_TO_PAGE
regions.description: Byte offset 0x400000: Array of 1024 uint32 pageIds mapping slot -> pageId.

regions.name: DIRTY_MASK
regions.description: Byte offset 0x401000: Bitmask (128 bytes = 1024 bits) tracking dirty slots.

regions.name: VM_CONTEXT
regions.description: Byte offset 0x401080: Execution context frames for the SQL VM.

regions.name: RESULT_BUFFER
regions.description: Byte offset 0x404080: Output buffer for query result rows.

regions.name: BYTECODE
regions.description: Byte offset 0x414080: Instruction buffer for compiled bytecode routines.

regions.name: PAGE_SCRATCHPAD
regions.description: Byte offset 0x41C080: Staging buffer for page compression or I/O reassembly.

regions.name: ALIGNMENT_PADDING
regions.description: Byte offset 0x41D080: Padding aligning transient arena to 0x420000.

bufferPool.endOffsetDescription: Byte offset 0x420000: Start of dynamic transient query execution arena.

postConstants.name: TOTAL_MEMORY_BYTES
postConstants.description: Total buffer pool and shared Wasm memory allocation in bytes (20.125 MB).
